title: 1620 Prairie's mansard straightened, and the house painted olive green
items: 1620 Prairie's mansard now rises in straight, steep faces as the 1874 engraving draws it, instead of bowing out in a curve, and its upper deck sits lower, so the roof no longer swells over the walls.
The crown over the north pavilion keeps its upright faces with only a slight rounding at the top.
The walls are painted olive green over their brick, the colour the Inter Ocean gave the house in 1887; the exact shade is a reconstruction.
